command:
"=== check stuck processes ==="
Get-Process -Name "java","gradle" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name, Id, @{n="Min";e={[math]::Round(((Get-Date)-$_.StartTime).TotalMinutes,1)}}
"=== kill stuck gradle/java ==="
Get-Process -Name "java","gradle" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force
Start-Sleep -Seconds 3
"=== fresh build ==="
$app = "C:\Users\Abdullah G\Desktop\Website\flip-scanner-app"
$android = Join-Path $app "android"
git -C $app fetch origin 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 1
git -C $app reset --hard origin/main 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 1
$env:JAVA_HOME = "C:\Users\Abdullah G\Desktop\Website\flip-scanner\tools\jdk-21"
$env:ANDROID_HOME = "C:\Users\Abdullah G\Desktop\Website\flip-scanner\Android\Sdk"
$env:ANDROID_SDK_ROOT = $env:ANDROID_HOME
$env:Path = "$env:JAVA_HOME\bin;$env:Path"
cd $android
.\gradlew.bat assembleDebug --rerun-tasks 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 30
"=== APK? ==="
Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $android "app\build\outputs\apk\debug") -Filter "*.apk" | Select-Object Name, @{n="MB";e={[math]::Round($_.Length/1MB,1)}}
